scope: Author-side review of 33 route sequences, questions, transitions, materials and both evidence tracks. Stop anchors are UI reading positions; archaeological and other dates retain the qualifications in each stop and dossier.
durationMethod: All displayed durations are editorial estimates. No participant timing was collected. Adult-guided family route for ages 10–14; adult self-directed route also reviewed.
prerequisites: For each route the family card supplies the text, notice prompts, source and feedback needed for its task. Where it calls for a pictured object, select the linked object. Adults may use the stop dossiers, linked objects and cited selections for the return question.
navigationScope: Every stop, optional stop object, comparison target, family citation and adult citation was checked against the corpus. Exact order and anchor years are retained below. Browser resume and reset checks are recorded separately from this editorial review.
